snippet.title: Hotel Magnate 1.0 Launch Trailer | Build the Hotel of Your Dreams
snippet.description:
Ever dreamed of running your own hotel, motel, or resort?
With Hotel Magnate you can design, build, and manage the hotel of your dreams — or nightmares! From rundown motels to elegant resorts, you’ll have a huge toolbox of customisation options, facilities to construct, and quirky guests to impress.

✨ Hotel Magnate 1.0 is out now! ✨
Play it today on Steam 🎮🕹️: https://bit.ly/2HNUdZ6

🌐 Website: http://hotel-magnate.com

📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hotelmagnate/
